principles.principle: Focus on user-visible behavior, not implementation details
Prefer semantic locators over XPath or CSS selectors
Document with FN: headers for agent readability

boundaries.rule: Test files must be in tests/e2e/ui/ directory
Page Objects must be in tests/e2e/ui/pages/ directory
Test data must be loaded from assets/test_data/
Fixtures must be defined in conftest.py

validation.rule: After creating tests, verify they run independently
Ensure locators are resilient to UI changes
Check FN: headers are complete and accurate

step.name: parse_story
step.description: Extract key elements from user story

step.name: map_to_locators
step.description: Map story elements to Playwright locators

guidance.rule: Identify UI elements by their visible text or role

step.name: define_assertions
step.description: Define assertions based on expected outcomes
